newsitem.title: USA: Gaylord names COO London president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Gaylord names COO London president, CEO.

text.p: Gaylord Entertainment Co said on Thursday its board appointed chief operating officer Terry London president and chief executive officer of the company, effective on May 1 with the retirement of long-time president E.W. Wendell.
Wendell who is 69 will remain a consutant to the company. He has been president of Gaylord and its predecessor company since 1978.

London, 47, was appointed chief operating officer of the company on March 3, a month after Gaylord entered into a definitive agreement with Westinghouse Corp and its television unit CBS to acquire Gaylord's two major cable networks along with a number of other properties.
London previously served as chief financial officer, a position he has held since Gaylord became public in 1991.

The company said it does not plan to fill the chief operating officer's position in the immediate future. A re-evaluation of the position will be made after the Westinghouse/CBS transaction has been completed, it said.
It said it is currently conducting a search for a chief financial officer.
Gaylord is a diversified entertainment and communications company operating in cable networks, entertainment and broadcasting.
